name: Hifumi
tagline: Flashcards made just for the Minna no Nihongo textbooks
description:
Hifumi is a flashcard companion built specifically for people studying with the Minna no Nihongo Shokyu I and II textbooks, a very popular set of Japanese language courses. Instead of generic vocabulary lists, the cards line up directly with what you're learning chapter by chapter.

It's a small, focused tool that fits neatly alongside your textbook study routine.
